description: Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 240859 granted 22/07/2024 for changes to roof plan to include 7no PV panels, Arboricultural Impact Assessment (AIA) updated to include additional tree works and changes to hours of operation to 07:00 to 22:00 for Class F1 and Class E uses.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number 300_C_111_02 Rev 05 dated 23rd October 2025.

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall fully conform with the recommendations of Arboricultural Impact Assessment 230971-PD-11b and&nbsp;Arboricultural Addendum&nbsp;</span>230971-PD-19b dated October 2025. The development shall be carried out solely in accordance with the approved details, all works shall comply with BS 3998:2010 (Tree Work - Recommendations) and shall be supervised by a suitably qualified Arboriculturalist and any post-construction mitigation measures shall thereafter be maintained for the lifetime of the development.</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The Class F1 use hereby approved shall only operate between the hours of 07:00 - 22:00 (Monday to Sunday).</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The Class E(b) use hereby approved shall only operate between the hours of 07:00 - 22:00 (Monday to Sunday).</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The Class E(c) and E(g) use hereby approved shall only operate between the hours of 07:00 - 22:00 (Monday to Sunday).</span></p>
